digest.component_or_area: LLM provider routing and model-class configuration
propositions: Four hand-built LLM sub-call sites bypass model-class configuration by passing raw cfg without declaring a model class, causing them to inherit cfg.model instead of the configured class
overlap-judge dominates plan-review traffic with 18 of 23 calls, all routed to direct Anthropic instead of configured Bedrock when classes are set but cfg.model is left bare
ticket-digest runs on the store write path via enrich_drain, sending ticket content to direct Anthropic during routine rebar comment/create operations with no gate visibility

Three of the four bypass sites (ticket-digest, overlap-judge, code-novelty) must be fixed to select from the class vocabulary with explicit reasoning, while ticket-quality (single top-level op call) should remain on cfg.model by design
An AST-based provenance guard must prevent future hand-built RunRequest sites from silently reintroducing the config bypass by tracing config= expressions and flagging raw inheritance
Regression tests must construct the overlap-judge trigger deliberately by ensuring BM25F candidates exist, as running a gate alone produces zero judge calls and provides false coverage
